description: The tank yard behind the pumps, chain-link on three sides and open to the sky: drums stacked to head height, a spill tray gritty with absorbent, hoses coiled like sleeping snakes. A NO SMOKING sign has been shot clean through. It reeks of diesel and hot rubber.

window.description: A window set too high in the wall to see the ground through, so it offers the sky and nothing else. On a bad day that is more information than you want.
window.name: the high window

name: Flash Point Fuel
